headline_source: ICPAC OND 2026 outlook + Beelove climate model
disclaimer: National outlook. Read it alongside the official Kenya Meteorological Department forecast and what you can see in your own field.

2026-09.label: September 2026
2026-09.action: SHORT RAINS APPROACHING - stronger than normal expected. Move hives OFF flood-prone ground now. Check stands are above the flood line and roofs and ventilation are sound.

2026-10.label: October 2026
2026-10.action: HEAVY SHORT RAINS. Inspect apiaries after every storm for flooding and hive damage. Bees fly little in continuous rain - leave their stores alone.
2026-10.source: ICPAC OND 2026: 90% chance enhanced rainfall NE Kenya; >400mm central Kenya

2026-11.label: November 2026
2026-11.action: PEAK WET SEASON. A strong bloom follows this rain. Clean and bait spare hives NOW - heavy flowering brings swarming and free colonies to anyone who is ready.
2026-11.source: ICPAC OND 2026 outlook; El Nino + positive IOD

2026-12.label: December 2026
2026-12.action: Bloom building. Keep bait hives out. Do NOT harvest wet - test moisture before extracting anything.

2027-01.label: January 2027
2027-01.action: Main harvest window. Test EVERY batch with the refractometer - wet-season honey above 20% moisture will ferment and is not sellable.

2027-02.label: February 2027
2027-02.action: Post-harvest. Consolidate weak colonies and treat empty boxes for wax moth while they are off the hives.

2027-03.label: March 2027
2027-03.action: Long rains beginning. Re-check drainage and hive stands before the ground softens.
2027-03.source: Seasonal normal; IOD/ENSO signal weak in MAM

2027-04.label: April 2027
2027-04.action: Long rains bloom. Add supers to strong colonies and keep spare boxes ready.
2027-04.source: Seasonal normal; IOD/ENSO signal weak in MAM

2027-05.label: May 2027
2027-05.action: Good forage. Watch for swarming - split strong colonies before they leave.

2027-06.label: June 2027
2027-06.action: Forage declining. Leave enough stores in the hive; do not over-harvest.

2027-07.label: July 2027
2027-07.action: Dry season. Put clean water near the apiary and reduce entrances against robbing.

2027-08.label: August 2027
2027-08.action: Driest period. Monitor hive weight. Feed only colonies that are genuinely light.
